metadata.name: GetAccountBalance
metadata.description: This method is used to get Account Balance Details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of AccountNumber or AdminNumber is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Condition: At least one of AccountNumber or AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TotalAmountDue
children.description: Total amount due as on statement date. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance of account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: PaymentDueDate
children.description: Due date as to by when payment needs to be made to avoid late fees. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: LastPaymentAmount
children.description: Last payment amount on the account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: LastPurchaseAmount
children.description: Last Purchase Amount as on statement date. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: RecentPurchasesAndDebits
children.description: Purchase and Debits made on current statement recently. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: RecentPaymentsAndCredits
children.description: Payments and Credits made on current statement recently. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: LastStatementBalance
children.description: Balance of previous statement. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: NextStatementDate
children.description: Next Date for Statement Generation. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: CreditLimit
children.description: Total Credit Limit on account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: MaskedCardNumber
children.description: Masked Card Number. Format: XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX Example: 4567 89XX XXXX 0123 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AvailableCreditLimit
children.description: Total Credit limit minus the total amount due. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: LastPaymentDate
children.description: Date of last payment transaction. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: PreviousStatementDate
children.description: Date of Previous Statement. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/25/2020 00:00:00

children.name: BeginningRewardBalance
children.description: Reward balance at the beginning of Statement. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: RewardEarned
children.description: Reward Earned in statement Cycle. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: RewardRedeemed
children.description: Reward points Redeemed in statement Cycle. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: AvailableRewardBalance
children.description: Number of Available Reward Balance. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: RewardExpired
children.description: Number of Expired Rewards. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234567.123, 1234567.1234

children.name: RewardForfeited
children.description: Number of Forfeited Rewards. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: This tag reflects the customer ID. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example: 12345 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CardNumberLast4Digit
children.description: Last 4 digits of card number. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: CardStatus
children.description: Status of the requested card. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Format: xxx xxx Example: New Card Pending Activation.Cancelled etc Allowable Values: 50
